description: Search tools across every u.cash MCP server by name or description (case-insensitive substring), optionally scoped to one server. Returns the tool, a one-liner, its server, and how to connect. Discovery only - connect to that server directly; no call is ever proxied.

q.description: substring matched over tool name + description

server.description: optional: restrict to one fleet server name

name: uxc_discover_tools
